data.explanation: The tax office (Finanzamt Musterhöhe) has finished processing your 2025 income tax return. You overpaid during the year, so you get a credit (Guthaben) of €713.00, which will be transferred to the bank account on file. No payment is due from you. If you disagree with the calculation (e.g. the deductions applied), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office — the app shows until when this is possible based on when the letter is deemed delivered. Otherwise, no further action is needed; keep this notice for your records as it may be relevant for future tax matters.
